name: agenttop
description: htop for AI coding agents — real-time token, cost, and duration monitor for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI and more

scripts.build: bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/agenttop src/cli.ts && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/agenttop-darwin src/cli.ts && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/agenttop-darwin-arm64 src/cli.ts && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/agenttop-linux-arm64 src/cli.ts

author: SalzDevs
